shortBulletSummary: Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech hikes September rate odds to ~60%, hitting crypto.
Bitcoin drops below $78K as BTC ETFs see first outflow in nine days post-hawkish Fed.
ETH dips to $2,436; US spot ETH ETFs see $1.5B inflows, sparking bullish long-term predictions.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index eases slightly to 68 (Greed), but remains elevated.
US national debt over $40T may boost crypto demand as fiat alternative, says Grayscale.
